entries.description: H fixes the two interval endpoints at y0 for every parameter; its top/bottom/intermediate slices are based loops a1,a0,ar. The mathematical family is linear interpolation of two finite Fourier plane loops, with coefficients chosen to follow the scan contours; endpoints agree exactly as real functions, up to floating arithmetic in evaluation. Native path samples evaluate the actual loop parameterizations, rather than drawing an unrelated filled band.
